stem.text: A rigid uniform bar of length $2.4\,\text{m}$ is pivoted horizontally at its midpoint.

stem.alt: Horizontal bar with a triangular pivot at its midpoint, a 200 N weight hung from its left side and a 300 N weight hung from its right side, with 0.8 m dimension arrows.

stem.text: Weights are hung from two points on the bar as shown in the diagram. To maintain equilibrium, a couple is applied to the bar.
What is the torque and direction of this couple?
